title: solar.pvdaq.dataset.available.v1
description: CloudEvents v1.0 envelope emitted by ingestion-func onto the queue raw-energy-events once an exact source copy of a PVDAQ CSV has landed in the bronze container. Consumed by processing-func. Target state per ADR 0002 (versioned type + dataschema), ADR 0003 (correlation_id + real traceparent) and ADR 0005 (blob-form storage_path).

type.description: ADR 0002: {domain}.{vendor}.{entity}.{action}.v{major}. The consumer MUST assert this value and dead-letter anything else.

source.description: Logical producer identity. Never names a storage layer (ADR 0002 rule 3).

id.description: Unique event identifier. New on every emission, including re-drives.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data member. The Service Bus message itself carries application/cloudevents+json (ADR 0002 rule 4).

dataschema.description: ADR 0002 rule 2: pins the exact contract in the registry. Equals this schema's $id. A minor (additive) revision keeps the type string and moves this URI.

source_vendor.description: Vendor identity; first key of the schema-registry lookup.

schema_version.description: Vendor record-schema version; second key of the schema-registry lookup.

mapping_version.description: Vendor field-mapping version. 'unknown' is the explicit dataset-level sentinel: no field mapping is applied at this level. ADR 0006 narrows this to ^v[0-9]+$ once per-device mappings are published; until then the sentinel MUST be derived from configuration rather than hardcoded (R2.3).

correlation_id.description: ADR 0003 business key: one per ingested file/batch, stable across retries and re-drives. Also set on the Service Bus message's CorrelationId property.

ingestion_timestamp.description: When ingestion finished writing the source copy to bronze.

traceparent.description: ADR 0003: W3C trace context derived from the live span at emission — never synthesised. Also written to the Service Bus application properties; this envelope copy is the durable record that survives replay.

data.description: Dataset payload. Open by construction: ADR 0002 rule 2 makes additive data fields a minor version, so a consumer validating against this copy must still accept an event carrying a field it has not seen (for example the device_id of ADR 0006). Unknown ENVELOPE attributes, by contrast, are rejected.

file_format.description: Bronze holds the source bytes as fetched (ADR 0001).

storage_path.description: Absolute blob-endpoint URI of the source copy (ADR 0005): https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/{container}/{path}, or the Azurite http form locally. The abfss:// scheme is no longer emitted, and spaces must be percent-encoded rather than passed literally.

version.description: Append-only ingestion version of this dataset. Emitted today but rejected by the superseded specs/ contract, which closed data with additionalProperties:false — this contract admits it (R1.1).

ingestion_id.description: Identifies this ingestion run. Equals correlation_id for a single-file ingestion.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest computed while streaming.

uuid.description: Lowercase canonical UUID. The pattern is carried alongside the format so validation is deterministic wherever format assertion is disabled.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit offset.

allOf.description: W3C forbids an all-zero trace-id; it is also the signature of a synthesised context (ADR 0003).
